the_single_operation.why_exact_only: Exact match confines the keyword to the query 'boiler repair' and its close variants. It cannot reach oil, steam, commercial, industrial, installation, replacement, parts, manual, DIY or jobs queries, because each of those adds a content word that changes meaning and is therefore not a close variant. That containment is what makes the addition safe without opening broader Phrase traffic.

no_negatives_and_why.reasoning: Negatives were tested for NECESSITY, not added for activity. With an EXACT-only keyword every problematic query was verified NOT to serve, so no negative would ever fire. Adding them would be inert configuration.

candidates_deliberately_NOT_added.steam boiler: WITHDRAWN. A steam boiler may be gas-fired, so absence of the word 'steam' from the page is not evidence of irrelevance. No verified client service source was consulted.
candidates_deliberately_NOT_added.boiler installation: WITHDRAWN. Absence of an installation page does not prove Ambient does not install boilers. Legacy campaigns in this very account were named 'Gas Boilers Installs' and 'Tankless Boilers', which is affirmative evidence AGAINST negating it.
candidates_deliberately_NOT_added.commercial boiler: WITHDRAWN. The page states 'Gas boiler repair for homes and businesses'.
candidates_deliberately_NOT_added.industrial boiler: WITHDRAWN. No verified service source confirms exclusion.
candidates_deliberately_NOT_added.oil boiler: WITHDRAWN. No verified service source confirms exclusion; the main site does list oil furnace installations and oil replacement.
candidates_deliberately_NOT_added.water heater / boiler parts / boiler man: Conflict testing passes for all five, but they are UNNECESSARY under Exact match and are therefore not added. They become candidates again only if a future stage introduces Phrase match.
